cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Come sit beside me at dinner. I know you're still angry I missed your opening night. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left that seat empty. You can have an empty one tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I deserved that last night. Could tonight's seat have you in it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm still going to tell you what you missed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please do. Move your plate over; I want to hear every scene.
